notes.title: Expedition Zero Patch 1.13.1 is live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36908542/958cacb5755a0e89a7a58311d8816e8113a2b2ef.jpg[/img]

Hello survivors,

Thank you for your feedback as we continue to improve and update Expedition Zero. 

In this update we wanted to completely redesign the narrative part of the game by introducing a lot of new story details for players to experience on their quest to cure the plague. You’ll be able to discover a lot of new little details about the events that have unfolded in the zone making the whole immersion deeper.

With all the recent updates, the game has undergone quite a few changes. We'd appreciate it if you play the latest one and tell us what you think in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1247570/Expedition_Zero/]Steam Reviews[/url]!

As always, please [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]join our Discord server[/url] to share your feedback or bug reports with us, and keep an eye out for more patches and updates.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h2]Updated story line[/h2]
Explore the desolation zone and become the liquidator of a dangerous contamination that has spread across it. Use your Locator to find the hotspots and clear them. Look for clues and learn more about each of the infections. You can find the Locator in the abandoned military camp so don’t miss it! 

We’ve also added a few little details here and there (dead bodies, warning signs, other objects) to make the environment more detailed and interesting to explore. 

[h2]New save system[/h2]
To make it even more realistic, we’ve removed a ‘save’ option from the game menu. You’ll need to use beds to save your progress now, so plan accordingly! 

[h2]New visual effects[/h2]
[list]
[*] Your Locator will now play various visual effects when interacting with different infections
[*] Artifacts now have more details representing the infection on them, and will no longer disappear after you interact with them. Instead you will need to purge the infection from it and when it’s done, the new visual effects will appear indicating that the infection is now gone.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/rmhqpWv.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an incorrect animation for the Trader at the Wall that occured for some players
[*] Added a new artifact (infection) effect to the save system. When the game is loaded, the corresponding state of the artifact will now appear.
[*] Added extra infection details to the artifacts, so the infections look more spread out on top of it. 
[*] Locator now gets autoselected when pressing ‘E’ on interacting with artifacts to clear the infection.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Join us on social media[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/ExpeditionZero]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Expedition Zero Patch 1.12.0 is live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36908542/ee4ea3676a1c4accc9df87b25a40b2e1012238ed.png[/img]

Hello survivors,

Thank you for your feedback as we continue to improve and update Expedition Zero. 
In this update we've tweaked Strigoi's behavior, introduced the new quest in the shop location, and made a few quality-of-life improvements. 

With the latest updates, the game has undergone quite a few changes. We'd appreciate it if you play the latest one and tell us what you think in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1247570/Expedition_Zero/]Steam Reviews[/url]!

As always, please [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]join our Discord server[/url] to share your feedback or bug reports with us, and keep an eye out for more patches and updates.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h2]New Shop Quest and Artifact[/h2]
There’s a new building out there on the outskirts! Will you have the courage to solve the mystery behind the portals and get your hands on the artifact that's hiding in the dungeon underneath the shop? Let us know if you managed to pass through the portals! 

[h2]Strigoi Balance[/h2]
We’ve also made a few adjustments to the general balance of Strigoi.
[list]
[*] [b]Strigoi is no longer summoned immediately[/b] after the game has been loaded.
[*] [b]Increased the Strigoi's rebirth time[/b] from 15 to 30 minutes to limit its presence.
[*] [b]Decreased number of artifacts[/b] that summon Strigoi when deactivated.
[/list]
[h2]QOL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two ranged weapons and one melee weapon slot have been added to the inventory
[*] Minimap improvements: PLayer’s position is now shown as an arrow instead of a dot for better orientation. 
[*] Added additional blood stains for players to better orientate near the crash site.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some players to see their game crash in the Forest area. If you still experience this issue, please let us know in the comments here or in our Discord server.
[*] Players won’t be able to refine their quest items anymore.
[/list]
[h1]Join us on social media[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/ExpeditionZero]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Expedition Zero Patch 1.11.1 is live
notes.notes:
Hello survivors,

Thank you for your feedback as we continue to improve and update Expedition Zero. 
This patch features [u][b]a new update to the School location[/b][/u] and a few minor bug fixes.

Just like in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1247570/view/3180115601628633013]previous update[/url] we continue to improve the overall gaming experience for some of the locations and structures players encounter in the game. This is done to better suit the general atmosphere of the game and to better immerse players.

As always, please [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]join our Discord server[/url] to share your feedback or bug reports with us, and keep an eye out for more patches and updates.

[h2]School update[/h2]
If you're lucky enough to stumble across a large, ruined and scary school building, don't rush out of there! You should look inside to find a new puzzle that will open up an underground passageway with a new artifact waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36908542/86eeeb6fe701cfe25409602ab64f4520263d8089.jpg[/img]

[*] Fixed an issue where weapons on some players could incorrectly display the reload animation.  
[*] Fixed some collisions on levels. Players will no longer be able to go beyond the boundaries of the levels.

Hello survivors,

Thank you for your feedback as we continue to improve and update Expedition Zero. 
This new update features[u][b] a couple of new intriguing quests[/b][/u] for you to complete!

[h2]New Quests[/h2]

[h3]An Abandoned Farmhouse[/h3]
Visit a desolate farm and uncover the frightening secrets that lie hidden there. Explore its surroundings for a clue and find your way into the basement to get your hand on a new artifact.

[h3]Plane Crash Site[/h3]
Find the crash site and try to get inside the plane. Examine the cockpit and start your search from there. Perhaps the pilots left some clues? Who knows, you might find something useful inside the cabin!

notes.title: Expedition Zero Patch 1.01.8 is live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36908542/e0cc587f59ad8322a03ed1b0d66315136200a139.jpg[/img]

Hello survivors,

Thank you for your feedback as we continue to improve and update [b]Expedition Zero[/b]. This [b]patch 1.01.8[/b] is a relatively big one and introduces quite a few changes and additions to the game. So let’s talk about all of this in order! 

As always, please [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]join our Discord server[/url] to share your feedback or bug reports with us, and keep an eye out for more patches and updates.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h2]New monster type - A Bear[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eVtep2Y.gif[/img]

This new monster that lurks behind the trees in the dark has [b]plenty of health[/b] and [b]incredibly strong attacks[/b]. So it's best you don't get caught in the act!
[list]
[*] [b]We’re also introducing the new type of flares[/b] that can be found around. You can use more strategic moves by throwing them to distract monsters and get yourself a few seconds to get away.
[*] [b]We’ve also adjusted and added new safe zones where players can not be attacked by Strigoi.[/b] 
[*] These zones are now functioning correctly. Keep an eye out on some new places to hide, like concrete pipes and huts! 
[/list]
[h2]Controller support (beta)[/h2]
Controllers can now be used to play Expedition Zero. [u]We’re still working on this[/u], so if you have any feedback or if you encounter any issues, please let us know in the comments or [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]in our Discord server[/url]. 
[list]
[*] We’re introducing the new tutorial for players who use controllers. This will be detected automatically and players will see different UI when playing on different devices.
[*] Players can adjust the sensitivity and inversion settings for their controllers.
[/list]
[h2]QOL and various fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a new set of sounds and a gas mask icon[/b] when players enter the radiation cloud.
[*] [b]Improved the landscape visualization[/b] to make the navigation a bit easier
[*] [b]Players can now find and repair some of the broken heaters and battery chargers[/b] to have more resource control over the map.
[*] [b]Improved UI for powering Suit Modules[/b] – more clear power state and on-screen button to turn it ON/OFF (instead of right-click context menu).
[*] Fixed an issue where subtitles could have disappeared too early.
[*] Fixed an issue where subtitles were not pausing when the game was on pause.
[/list]
[h1]Join us on social media[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/ExpeditionZero]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Expedition Zero Patch 1.01.5 is live
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36908542/ceb591edd6063e9b99ea11b2e46a9705f2059499.png[/img]

Hello survivors,

We continue to improve Expedition Zero and the newest [b]Patch 1.01.5 is now live[/b]. This one features some major updates to the AI of the Undead Villagers and general balancing of the game.

Please [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]join our Discord server[/url] to share your feedback or bug reports with us, and keep an eye out for more patches and updates.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[h2]Major Undead Villager Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]More realistic AI[/b] — it's more aggressive now, but could be outplayed with stealth, so plan your attack accordingly. 
[*] [b]Increased HP, speed, size and damage[/b] making them a real threat! 
[*] [b]New walk animation[/b]. 
[*] [b]New attack animation and timings[/b], including melee attacks balance. 
[*] [b]Improved sound effects[/b] for the Undead Villager and melee combat. 
[/list] 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PJkckWk.gif[/img]

[h2]Game Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Item spawn system has been fixed and rebalanced[/b]. It will now take the player's inventory into account to create more intense gameplay situations.
[*] Infinite spawn bug is fixed.
[*] [b]Medical spawning points[/b] have been improved and rebalanced so players can now find more healing items.
[*] [b]Ammo spawn rates[/b] have been adjusted and rebalanced.
[/list]
[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added UI toggle buttons to modules instead of right click.
[*] Players can now use double click or Ctrl + click to move items around faster.
[*] Improved saving on multiple locations (e.g. Church).
[*] Mobs will not respawn upon game load if they were killed before saving the game.
[*] Fixed multiple movement glitches.
[/list]
[h1]Join us on social media[/h1]
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/yXPHUzE4Sr]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/ExpeditionZero]Twitter[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Expedition Zero Patch 1.01.1 is live
notes.notes:
Hello survivors,

First and foremost, we’d like to thank everyone for the support and feedback that we’re getting since the release of Expedition Zero yesterday. It’s very much appreciated!

We have seen all your bug reports and suggestions, and we will definitely continue to improve the game and your experience in the future. Our plan is to release regular updates that will be aimed at improving the quality of life, fixing bugs that arise and making changes to the gameplay.

And we'll be starting right now with the update 1.01.1 now available for download.
We’re already working on the next update that will address even more issues as well as introducing some in-game settings adjustments.

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Medicine:[/b] Bandages were temporarily removed from the game to investigate some incorrect behavior of the item.
[*] Added more pills for players to heal even more effectively.
[*] Removed a blocker in the Forest level in order to have access to the charger in one of the tents.
[*] Fixed the position of the Relay Station elevator. 
[*] Fixed an issue with shadows in the first location.
[/list]
Again, thank you so much for your input and feedback as we continue to improve Expedition Zero! Keep an eye out for more news and updates in the coming days!
